dedupe_keys.name: asce report card for america s infrastructure 2025

description: The ASCE Report Card for America's Infrastructure gives letter grades to the state of US infrastructure, sector by sector, with a report for each category. The 2025 edition covers 18 categories, with grades ranging from B for ports to D for stormwater and transit, and reports that 8 categories saw grade increases since the previous card; it also estimates a 10-year investment gap of about 3.6 trillion dollars and links to state report cards and an interactive StoryMap. It is produced by the American Society of Civil Engineers. The grades, category reports and summary material are available free on the report card website; no licence is named, so reuse terms should be checked with ASCE. Caveats: the grades are summary judgements for whole sectors and are not an asset-level dataset. It is useful as a national condition and investment-need baseline for multi-sector infrastructure planning and ageing studies; a related record is the HIFLD open infrastructure data.
name: ASCE Report Card for America's Infrastructure (2025)
